extension.description: Live Streaming, Replay the last week, LA7 Prime, On-Demand programs, News and Weather, Teche LA7-The Protagonists
Diretta Live, Rivedi ultima settimana, LA7 Prime, Programmi On-Demand, Telegiornali e Meteo, Teche LA7-I Protagonisti
extension.news:
7.2.6 (2026-11-01) - List the episodes of a program from the archive the site uses: 20 per page, newest first, instead of a few episodes mixed with the reruns of the week
7.2.5 (2026-11-01) - Show the categories of a program in Kodi too: they were added after the directory was closed, so only the last videos appeared
7.2.4 (2026-11-01) - Reload the add-on code on every call, so an update takes effect without restarting Kodi
7.2.3 (2026-11-01) - Open the categories of a program (Puntate, Clip, …) with paginated access to the whole archive - Log the categories found on a program page, to compare the add-on with the site - Do not mistake a video for a category of its own program
7.2.2 (2026-11-01) - Browse again after the la7.it -> la7play.it migration: replay, programs, films, documentaries and search read the new site - Play the live channels from the DASH manifest and the token the la7play player uses - Add the Documentari section, drop the sections the site no longer publishes (Personaggi, LA7 Eventi, TG & Meteo, Film e Fiction, Non Classificati) - Play clear content with Kodi's own player, inputstream.adaptive is only needed for DRM - Show an error message instead of failing when a page cannot be read
7.1.0 (2026-10-08) - Added Search function - Fix Personalities biography - LA7 Meteo replaced with Omnibus Meteo in the News and Weather section
7.0.0 (2025-10-23) - LA7d channel replaced with the new LA7 Cinema - New channel LA7 Eventi - Review function of the new LA7 Cinema channel - Added Tutti i Film page in the La7 Prime section - TG La7d replaced with TG Digital in the News and Weather section - Omnibus News replaced with Edicola in the News and Weather section - Protagonist section replaced with Personalities section
6.3.0 (2025-05-11) - fix Programs title and added Config for manual added programs (thanks @24mu13) - patch text not found (thanks @lpuglia)
6.2.1 (2024-05-09) - Solved program cataloging (thanks @fabpolli)
